dedupe_keys.name: leo constellation real time interactive simulation digital twin platform dayilixiang v4

description: Sida Li at Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, publishes dayilixiang-v4, a packet-level discrete-event platform for low-Earth-orbit satellite constellations. Built on Hypatia, it describes multi-shell Walker-delta configurations, SGP4 propagation, radio-frequency link budgets, rain attenuation, Doppler effects and DVB-S2 capacity. Ship AIS ingestion, a wall-clock-driven mode, CesiumJS visualisation and a Gymnasium routing interface are also documented. Zenodo preserves the July 2026 version 1.0.0 repository snapshot under MIT, free of charge. The authors report comparisons with 15,237 Starlink measurements, historical orbital elements and DWD precipitation observations; those validation claims were not independently reproduced. Simulation scale is constellation-wide, but the landing page does not establish every measurement location, date or time-step setting. The platform extends the catalogued model-hypatia. Runtime requirements and the contents of the archived release remain untested.
